hypothesis: Foreign components may differ from native tissue in robust relative morphology or equal-slide cohort context; visual shortlisting should precede independent prediction-influence explanation.
reference: one unit-normalized mean image embedding per fitting slide; equal slide weight; nearest five centroids
feature_truth_boundary: Detector receives image embeddings, relative physical coordinates and observed-RGB component indices only. Labels, annotation fractions, foreign masks, source IDs, donor IDs and synthetic positions are evaluation metadata only.
selection: No calibration or test predictions. Host-grouped cross-fitting estimates training-only out-of-fold behavior. Thresholds fit clean training-fold burden only. Primary robust_nn5 chosen before outcomes; all seven methods reported. No post-outcome primary switch.
limitations: No patient IDs; grouped by slide ID only
S1 donors are reused; cohort references may contain a donor from a fitting fold and cannot establish donor-disjoint generalization
Known right-edge embedding injection is preserved, not a pixel-level contaminant
Observed RGB components are approximate pieces; unmapped and empty cases are retained as abstentions
No automatic removal; hypothetical filtering is a safety diagnostic
No independent validation or clinically useful detector claim
